verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for a government online-filing portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only front-door probes. They show a ~3 KB JavaScript shell and a Cloudflare challenge, with no published information on operating windows, daily limits, or session timeouts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
